text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh... nice. That looks like something 
you could wear all the time. If it were 
me, I'd probably go with brown."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah-ha☆ Thought so! I'm going with black~ 
Hey, wanna get matching ones in different 
colors?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sounds great. Want to try it on?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Heh-heh-hehn♪ As I thought, this feels 
pretty good...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(H-Huh...? No way! You gotta be Jordaning 
me, right!?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh-well, I mean! It was great, but...! 
Maybe I should wait till my paycheck comes 
in~... kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see, they really are pretty pricey, 
huh... Well, let's come back and buy 'em 
together another time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... Ugh, such a drag... 
...Still, just one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm definitely getting back to my 
original figure. And then I'm totally 
gonna wear matching pants with City~~!!

Afterward, Tosen Jordan achieved her goal 
and pulled off wearing the skirt in style!
